name: net_overlay_states
description: The connection overlay, once in each of its states, as a networked window shows it over the match (the console's bronze plate and the loading screen's bar, never a modal; the plan bot plays my seat): reconnecting after a cut, its bar filling with the checkpoint's parts (a checkpoint past 1,024 bytes takes two; here the sequencer paces one part every half second, so the bar stands half full a while); catching up with its bar; back once the tab is back and level (while it was hidden the page title flashed), the caretaker holding the seat until the next build window opens; and desynced, saying a report was saved. Between them the overlay is gone. view_connection_overlay draws each state for the eye.

steps.msg: a live match shows no overlay

steps.assert: scene.overlay().state == 1 and scene.overlay().visible and scene.overlay().lines() == ['Reconnecting...', 'your towers keep firing']

steps.msg: the checkpoint's parts fill the bar

steps.assert: scene.client.hidden and scene.client.said_visibility == 1 and scene._bridge.flashing == scene.FLASH_TEXT
steps.msg: the tab hid: VISIBILITY hidden, and the page title flashes that the caretaker keeps the seat

steps.wait_until: not scene.client.hidden and not scene.client.catching_up and scene.overlay().state == 5

steps.assert: (back_lines[0] == 'Welcome back') and ((back_lines[1] == 'The caretaker hands back after the coming wave') == window_open) and back_lines[1].begins_with('The caretaker hands back after ')
steps.msg: back from another tab: the caretaker holds the seat until the next build window opens (after the coming wave while a window is open, else after this one)
the tab is back: the title flash stopped

steps.assert: scene.overlay().lines() == ['The lands fell out of step', 'A report was saved'] and scene.client.dump_path == 'user://desync/1-1.bin'
